subject: RFP: NimbusAI bake-off — credit incentive request
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex@NimbusAI.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: RFP: Redwood vs Stratus - request for evaluation credits

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the product overview on Friday. Nimbus is running a three-vendor bake-off (Redwood, Stratus, and Lakeflow) as part of an RFP for our customer-facing assistant project. We’re scheduled to start hands-on tests on 2026-11-18 and the technical team has asked whether Redwood can provide evaluation credits and a short trial extension to match competitor offerings.

Scope: generation & chat for ~20 heavy prompts, embeddings reranking, ~400k total tokens over two weeks (rough estimate).

Request: would Redwood be able to issue a temporary trial allowance (promo credits) or a short trial account with elevated quotas for 2 weeks? If we go with you after the bake-off we could convert to a committed Dedicated pilot.

Please let me know what you can offer (amount, duration) and any conditions — e.g., case study, public references, etc.

Best,
Alex
Alex Chen
Senior Product Manager, NimbusAI

Attachments: RFP_Nimbus_Topline.pdf
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: Redwood vs Stratus - request for evaluation credits

Hi team,

Forwarding a request from NimbusAI (see attached RFP summary). They want elevated trial quotas for a 2-week bake-off starting 11/18 — rough ask is ~400k tokens. Prospect mentions potential Dedicated pilot if they pick Redwood.

Can we approve something here? My suggested play: offer a capped promo allowance and require a short case-study / reference if they select us. Also we should offer a 1-hr onboarding with CS during the trial.

Questions for you:
- Aditya: ok to approve up to how much in promo tokens for this level of opportunity?
- Marcus: any product/ops constraints for short-term elevated quotas?
- Monica: can CS commit to one onboarding call on week 1 and quick SLA/response for the trial?

I’ve attached the RFP summary from the prospect.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: RFP_Summary_Nimbus.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: Redwood vs Stratus - request for evaluation credits

Camila — thanks for the heads up.

High level: I’m supportive of an incentive here; Nimbus looks like a mid-enterprise deal with real conversion potential given their commitment to a Dedicated pilot if they pick us.

Approval parameters I’d be comfortable with:
- Promo allowance: up to 150,000 token-equivalent credits (hosted API) for a 2-week window
- Additional extension or extra credits require written commitment (e.g., case study + HUBSpot deal created) or exec approval
- Must track via HubSpot deal and attach the promo code to the deal id

Please capture this in the internal approval stub so we have an audit trail. I’m attaching a short approval PDF you can use to log.

Aditya
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

Attachments: approval-stub.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: Redwood vs Stratus - request for evaluation credits

Agree with Aditya’s parameters. A couple of operational notes from my side:

- We can provision a temporary trial account with elevated quotas (hosted) but we should cap per-minute TPS and enforce prefix caching to avoid abuse.
- CS can run a single onboarding session (up to 60 minutes) during week 1; Monica to confirm availability.
- If Nimbus asks for Dedicated capacity during the bake-off, that’s a separate pilot — require separate PO/commit.

Camila: please proceed to offer 150k tokens, 2-week window, 1x onboarding session, track in HubSpot. If Nimbus pushes for more, escalate to me + Aditya and include a short justification.

Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex@NimbusAI.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Redwood vs Stratus - request for evaluation credits

Hi Alex — thanks for the RFP. Apologies for the brief back-and-forth internally; here’s what we can do to support Nimbus for the bake-off starting 11/18: 

Offer:
- 150,000 token-equivalent promo credits applied to a trial account (hosted API)
- Trial window: 2 weeks (11/18–12/02) with elevated quotas for the bake-off scope
- One 60-minute onboarding session with CS during week 1 (Monica will coordinate times)
- If Nimbus chooses Redwood after the bake-off we’ll include a path to a Dedicated pilot; any Dedicated pilot during the bake-off requires a separate PO.

Conditions:
- Promo code tied to HubSpot deal NIM-2026-07 (we’ll send the code via HubSpot and track usage)
- We ask for a short (2–3 paragraph) case-study or reference call if Redwood is selected; this is not mandatory to run the trial but will be required for additional extension credits.

Next steps:
1) If this works, confirm and I’ll provision the trial and share the promo code.
2) Book kickoff onboarding (Monica will reach out).
3) We’ll add the trial/update to the HubSpot deal so usage is tracked.

Sharing two links: strong-qa test account (read-only) and HubSpot deal for your reference.

Regards,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: onboarding-agenda.docx
Links: https://redwood.internal/trials/NIM-2026-07, https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Camila — thanks, that’s perfect. We’ll take the 150k token promo and schedule the onboarding for the first day of the bake-off. I’ll ask procurement to raise a PO for a potential Dedicated pilot if we proceed.

Please send the promo code and the onboarding window options.

Best,
Alex
